points.statement: Coordination needs to reveal a private fact's task consequence: who acts, what crosses the handoff boundary, where it goes, and which suffix follows.
points.quote: Coordination must reveal the task consequence of a private fact: who acts, what crosses the handoff boundary, where it goes, and which suffix follows.

points.statement: With the same local input, the correct actor, handoff item, and continuation all change.
points.quote: Agent AA receives the same local input in both cases, yet the correct actor, handoff item, and continuation all change.

points.statement: A sender-local consequence moves forward in a peer request; afterward the receiver generates its downstream skill path.
points.quote: A sender-local consequence travels forward inside a peer request, after which the receiver generates its downstream skill path.

points.statement: A peer-local capability consequence returns through bounded feedback; afterward the requester revises the work division.
points.quote: A peer-local capability consequence travels back through bounded feedback, after which the requester revises the division of work.

points.statement: Both directions need one explicit object with semantics that survive communication, resolution, and execution.
points.quote: Both directions require one explicit object whose semantics survive communication, resolution, and execution.

points.statement: Before resolution the schema carries a proposed SELF+REQ route; after resolution it carries role-local obligations entering execution.
points.quote: Before resolution it carries a proposed SELF+REQ route; after resolution the same schema carries the role-local obligations that enter execution.

points.statement: On the main forward route, the receiver uses REQ as condition and generates its downstream SELF path.
points.quote: In the main forward route, the receiver conditions on REQ and generates its downstream SELF path.

points.statement: Counterfactual interventions holding world, call schedule, and executor unchanged make requester revision and receiver execution follow injected task consequence in both directions.
points.quote: Counterfactual interventions that hold the world, call schedule, and executor unchanged make requester revision and receiver execution follow the injected task consequence in both directions.

points.statement: Executable task consequences serve as the coordination unit linking distributed local reasoning to verified joint action.
points.quote: These results identify executable task consequences as the coordination unit connecting distributed local reasoning to verified joint action.
